meta.name: test-assumptions
meta.description: Challenge a proposed solution by identifying and testing consequential assumptions. Use when the brief feels too certain or discovery reveals contradictions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把看似板上钉钉的方案拆开,找出关键假设并逐一验证,避免走错方向。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头的方案被说得太笃定,你想先验证关键假设再投入。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan's key assumptions before you commit to building it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a plan sounds too certain and you want to validate its key assumptions first.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 不会直接照方案往下做,而是先找出方案里会影响结果的关键假设,并逐条去检验。它依据任务上下文约定工作,并把实现、验证、部署与验收分开对待。
howto.when: 当需求简报显得过于确定,或调研中出现矛盾时触发。若由 @fde 调用,它会复用现有的脱敏数据包与范围,不重启设置、不重复已答问题。

say.text: 这个方案看着太顺了,帮我挑出关键假设并逐一验证
say.note: 它会列出假设并逐条检验

say.text: 调研结果和方案对不上,测一下方案背后的假设
say.note: 它会针对矛盾处展开检验

say.text: 按 @fde 的上下文继续,别重复问已答的问题
say.note: 它会接续现有范围直接测假设

howto.what_en: After install, Claude doesn't just run with the proposed solution: it first names the assumptions that affect the outcome and tests them one by one. It works from the supplied task context and keeps implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance distinct.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the brief feels too certain or discovery reveals contradictions. When called by @fde, it reuses the current sanitized packet and scope, and does not restart setup or re-ask answered questions.

say_en.text: This plan looks too clean. Find the key assumptions and test each one.
say_en.note: It lists assumptions and tests them

say_en.text: Discovery contradicts the plan. Test the assumptions behind it.
Continue from @fde's context, don't re-ask answered questions.
